chunks: And in the narration of Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Al-Fadl ibn Yunus, he said:
I asked Abā al-Ḥasan Mūsā عليه السلام about a man who married a woman, but did not consummate the marriage with her, and then she committed adultery.
He said: "They are to be separated, she is to receive the prescribed hadd punishment, and there is no dowry for her."
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a wife commits adultery before the marriage is consummated?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who committed zina after the marriage contract but before consummation. Imam Mūsā عليه السلام rules that the couple must be separated, the legal punishment is to be carried out, and she is not entitled to the dowry.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4454 - In a narration from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Al-Fadl ibn Yunus, he said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) about a man who married a woman but did not consummate the marriage, and then she committed adultery.
Imam (as) said: "They shall be separated, she shall receive the prescribed punishment, and she is not entitled to a dowry."
